{{See also|GlobalScale Devices|GlobalScale}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Marvell]] 88F3720 @1.2GHz :Dual-core ARM (Cortex-A53) *Memory: 1GB (DDR4) SDRAM *Storage: 8GB (eMMC), 4MB (SPI NOR) Flash :M.2 2280 (Key B) slot for SATA SSD *Network: 5x 1Gb Ethernet ports *USB: 1x USB 2.0, 1x USB 3.0 ports *PCI: 1x mPCIe (USB 2.0) slot for 3G/4G modem *Power Source: 12V/2A via barrel or PoE (af/at)
